SHIN_GETTER_TRANSFORM.title: Transform
SHIN_GETTER_TRANSFORM.description: Switch forms in this order: Shin Getter 1 -> Shin Getter 2 -> Shin Getter 3 -> Shin Getter 1.
SHIN_GETTER_SPIRIT_COMMAND.title: Spirit Command Card
SHIN_GETTER_SPIRIT_COMMAND.description: A card marked with [img=top,22x22]res://images/atlases/power_atlas.sprites/s_g_p_ki.tres[/img]. While you have Ki, it gains Retain. If your current Ki meets its requirement, it costs 1 less.
SHIN_GETTER_FORM_CARD.title: Form-Specific Card
SHIN_GETTER_FORM_CARD.description: A card with an effect specific to the current form.
SHIN_GETTER_INFINITE_EVOLUTION_TOTAL.des: Permanent growth this run: Strength: {Strength}; Dexterity: {Dexterity}; Max HP: {MaxHp}.
SHIN_GETTER_STACK.title: Stack
SHIN_GETTER_STACK.description: Add the printed values on the selected cards to this card's damage, up to a total of 50.
SHIN_GETTER_OPEN_GET_INTENT.title: Open Get
SHIN_GETTER_BEACON_PRISM_COLOR.title: Different Color
SHIN_GETTER_BEACON_PRISM_COLOR.descripti: Cards in Shin Getter's reward pool, Strike, Defend, Getter Beam, and Getter Launch use the Getter-line color. Cards from other characters, Colorless cards (including Status cards), Ancient cards, Event cards, and Curse cards count as a different color. Only cards drawn from the draw pile during your play phase are counted.
